the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: By Groupoids, group-scheme-over-field-separated the stabilizer group scheme G to U is separated. By Groupoids, diagonal the morphism j = (t, s) : R to U x_S U is separated. As U is the spectrum of a field, U x_S U is affine (by the construction of fibre products in Schemes, Section fibre-products). Hence R, being separated over the affine scheme U x_S U, is a separated scheme by Schemes, separated-permanence. (source lines 1176-1187)
